population: All 112 existing exposed J NLI inputs per backbone: 40 R5 pairs and 16 strong different-H pairs. Keep existing train/dev only as reporting slices; no training/selection.
intervention: Exactly learned_rule_head.choice_request(item, all original system messages, rotation) for audited eligible inputs. No new instruction, rewritten question, entity rendering, code prefix, or aggregation.
eligibility: single positive/negative identity options; unique nonempty explicit P/H; one fixed TASK menu plus one complete different-premise example with terminal label only; audited native system(s)+one user wrapper. Extra fixed facts, definitions, ambiguous boundaries, or unknown wrapper -> full K request. Unknown unsupported choice task -> untouched original messages/order None; caller must preserve native path.
inference: Same HF bf16 SDPA worker/model/config as K, JSON answer_choice prefix, two code rotations, semantic mean probabilities. Zero new training and zero native generation.
dedup: Full rendered prompt SHA256 independently per backbone, expected 224 logical -> 144 actual. No gold/pair/group metadata in eligibility or prompt. Exact hash duplicates reuse one forward via explicit map.
primary_control: K full-input base on same 112: cached 224 forwards per backbone, same rule/prefix/model/scoring. No newly trained K weights.
secondary_controls: E repeat_rendering under common literal bindings (different added-input control)
old direct vLLM code scoring (backend/prompt difference)
old combined head (strong system control, different budget)
reports: both-correct, reference, variant, valid invariance, endpoint gold-label accuracy
repairs, harms, decisions changed vs each control
per-order disagreement; request dedup / actual costs
constant positive/negative offline descriptive baselines, not candidate selection
decision: Do not adopt without both-backbone R5 improvement and preserved strong different-H sensitivity; no backbone-specific strategy picking. Development evidence only; D remains 0 inference.
limitations: Removing non-system messages is a deliberate research input-processing intervention, not unchanged formal full-input evaluation.
Dedup makes same-request decision invariance a program property, not learned correctness.
This request API has no full native generation/faithful explanation validation.
Audited constructor family only; not a universal inference-authority parser for arbitrary messages.
prior: RP kernel already failed to improve strong controls broadly; see nli_authority_scope.md. New trial differs by matched K definition/code-score interface, not by claiming removal has never been tested.
